add.name: video-interaction-mapper
add.purpose: Turns a UI screen recording into an annotated Figma storyboard: extracts key before/after states, infers triggers and places screenshots with interaction markers.
add.how_to_use: Use with the Figma MCP server when asked to map a recording's interaction states into Figma.
add.notes: UI/product storyboards rather than film; no repo license -> link-only.
